Feral Strike.name: Feral Strike
Feral Strike.description: The user puts the full strength of their animal body behind a single blow with its strongest weapon: a rabbit's kick, a bear's claws, a crocodile's jaws or a lizard's tail. It deals heavy slashing or bludgeoning damage that cracks worn armor and throws the target across the room; held back, it drops them winded and unable to fight until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.
